properties.description: Persistent URI identifying this Heritage Digital Twin.
URI of the heritage entity this is the digital twin of (HP1 has digital twin, referenced here in its inverse "is digital twin of" direction — HP1i).
Short human-readable label identifying this digital twin (e.g. "The HDT of the Great Gallery ceiling painting"), per D7.1's own worked example convention.
URI of the actor (person or organisation) that created/maintains this digital twin.
URIs of `heritage-proposition-set` instances currently valid as content of this digital twin (HP33 contains).

URIs of `heritage-proposition-set` instances formerly, but no longer, valid content (HP34 contained) — preserves referential integrity for prior scholarly references. This is how HC2 versioning works: superseding content moves from `containsPropositionSet` to here rather than being deleted.

URI of the `event` instance (co-typed hdto:HC11_Digital_Twin_Maintenance — see ogc.heritage.event's HDTO alignment note) that composed/most recently updated this digital twin (HP19 has composed, inverse direction — HP19i).
